title: The Similar case in the record
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：similar　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 similar 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the director wrote of ① a similar case in the record in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② so similar that nobody in the theatre would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the similar ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the similar case in the record that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too similar to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the similar ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a similar plan for the bridge, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as similar as the plan for the bridge they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was similar or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something similar, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite similar; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the similar ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, before dawn, she wrote of another similar case in the record in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less similar than anybody had expected. ⑩ The similar plan for the bridge that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the similar ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 相似（前置定语 a similar case in the record：1985 年导演在戏报里记下的那件相似的案例）
B. adj. 相似／类似（两处加强说法：so similar that … 与 no less similar than …）
C. adj. 相似／类似（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 相似（表语 too similar to do：母亲觉得它太相似，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 类似（前置定语 a similar plan for the bridge：叔叔把整件事称作一桩类似的造桥方案）
F. adj. 类似（同级比较 as similar as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩类似的造桥方案相比）
G. adj. 类似（后置定语 something similar：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 类似（受程度副词修饰 quite similar：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a similar case in the record
the similar case in the record that
a similar plan for the bridge
The similar plan for the bridge that

answers.why: similar 意为“相似”，1985 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件相似的案例”，此处作前置定语 a similar case in the record。
similar 意为“相似”，此处用 so similar that 结构，说它相似到戏院里没人敢靠近。
similar 意为“相似”，戏报上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的相似记录中相似的案例，等于最高级的说法。
similar 意为“相似”，母亲认为这件东西“太相似了，谁也用不上”，too similar to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
similar 意为“类似”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩类似的造桥方案”，此处作前置定语 a similar plan for the bridge。
similar 意为“类似”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩类似的造桥方案一样类似”，同级比较用 as similar as。
similar 意为“类似”，戏报上那半行字要的是“类似的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something similar。
similar 意为“类似”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当类似”，quite 修饰原级 similar。
similar 意为“类似”，no less similar than 表示“其类似不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之类似不亚于任何人的预料。
similar 意为“类似”，母亲 1997 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的类似造桥方案”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件相似的案例。（a similar case in the record）
它相似到戏院里没有一个人敢靠近。（so similar that …）
母亲觉得它太相似，谁也用不上。（too similar to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩类似的造桥方案。（a similar plan for the bridge）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩类似的造桥方案一样类似。（as similar as …）
到了 1992 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件类似的东西。（something similar）
answers: In 1985 the director wrote of a similar case in the record in the poster.
It was so similar that nobody in the theatre would go near it.
My mother thought it too similar to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a similar plan for the bridge.
He said nobody would call it as similar as the plan for the bridge they had once had.
By 1992 the poster asked for nothing but something similar.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 similar 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the director wrote of a similar case in the record in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the similar case in the record that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too similar to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a similar plan for the bridge, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite similar, and everybody laughed.
The similar ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
